value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks partly sunny with a high around 65°F, anywhere from 64 to 67 depending on the forecast. Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, turning east to northeast in the afternoon with gusts up to 17 mph. Rain could move in after 3 p.m., more likely into the evening, and it gets down to the 30s to low 40s overnight.
